relationships.evidence_quote: resiniferatoxin (RTX), a potent agonist of the transient receptor potential vanilloid 1 (TRPV1) ion channel

relationships.subject: resiniferatoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: RTX was associated with decreased "worst" pain intensity by 38% (pretreatment 8.4±0.4 vs. posttreatment 5.2±0.6)

relationships.subject: resiniferatoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: reduced opioid consumption by 57% measured at posttreatment day 15

key_findings: Single intrathecal RTX reduced worst pain by 38% and opioid use by 57% in refractory cancer pain (interim phase 1, n=19)
Adverse events included loss of heat sensitivity, urinary retention and transient QT prolongation
